review_type: Bounded content/claim consistency review; no manuscript edits, inference, or PDF-layout review.
reviewer: Separate task agent; previously implemented the local importer and competitor adapter, so this is not external or human validation.

evidence.values: selected count, correct count, calls, token sum, rounded recorded latency sum

evidence.conditional_bootstrap: Fixed observed cohort ranks and allocation; no population equivalence claim from [0,0].
evidence.all_pool_calls: Collection pays 5 calls per item; 720-call policy uses a subset.
evidence.gate: Frozen source allocation uses only allowed feature scores and IDs; reference and future members determine evaluation only.
evidence.negative_retention: Eight scores, two targets, four policies, five budgets retained. Primary 1.5B result not replaced by favorable secondary findings.

evidence.basis: Sections 6 and Appendix K describe confidence-based Jev-first cascades with oracle/cross-fitted thresholds; manuscript distinguishes its within-checkpoint batch replay instead of claiming reproduction.

evidence.derived_member_fixture: Not accepted by importer; saved explorer and competitor custom recipe reconstruction remain distinct
evidence.validation_scope: Synthetic and one hash-selected archived item are software compatibility checks, not user benefit.

evidence.scope: Historical frozen ZIP remains unchanged; the later diagnostic replay is linked as a separate package. No human study or independent inference replication is claimed.

closed_findings.finding: The 11 undefined resamples concern the 35B primary target; the retained secondary target has 17.
closed_findings.resolution: Manuscript now explicitly says 11 primary-target 35B AP resamples.

limitations: Numeric assertions were cross-checked against the public result, completion receipts, retained policy outcomes and frozen source; this receipt is not a fresh full bootstrap rerun.
Original private-byte authenticity and model-training contamination cannot be established from public hash witnesses.
CFP/page-layout compliance is outside this bounded review and is being checked separately.
No estimate of user efficiency, general routing optimality, cross-machine replication, or acceptance probability follows from this audit.
